retention_rationale: GDPR Art. 17 - Mandatory erasure of auth credentials and passwords
Internal ID reference integrity preservation; direct PII prohibited
Customer contact records must be erased upon right-to-be-forgotten request
Search index documents must be de-indexed to prevent user discovery
Statutory 7-year fiscal and tax accounting retention; PII masked
Erasure from all newsletter and marketing outbound campaign lists
Behavioral analytics permissible only with irreversible pseudonymization
Backup snapshots must apply customer exclusion filters on restore
